description: Compact public evidence for the original full-film case. Historical scripts are forensic records, not the portable Skill entry point.

scope.public: All 46 metrics inputs and all .py/.swift scripts under the case work directory and frozen original Skill.
scope.local_only: The original 35:29 film, all historical full-length and intermediate media, and the complete 68,516,873,763-byte local review bundle. The public catalog is a file inventory and integrity record; it does not mean the cataloged media has been uploaded.
scope.not_included: Raw chat transcripts, credential files, unknown source screenshots, and additional raw OCR logs outside the 46 audited metrics inputs.

secret_scan.limitations: Pattern-based screening is not proof that arbitrary private text or novel credential formats are absent. User-authorized source names and local paths are preserved as historical evidence.
